notes.title: The Plague Update
notes.content:
[p]After a successful launch, Team Countdown is happy to deliver the final update for Katharsi. We look forward to hearing your feedback on the updated environment and seeing you complete the achievements!

Changes we've made:[/p][list][*][p]More plague everywhere![/p][/*][*][p]Achievements[/p][/*][*][p]New sensors[/p][/*][*][p]Improved cutscenes[/p][/*][*][p]Updated credits[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixing[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for playing Katharsi, sharing your feedback and leaving your comments![/p]

notes.title: Softlock fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where the first waterwheel would fall prematurely and softlock the player
- changed the fallback button for the lightbeam onboarding to be LT instead of RT

notes.title: Katharsi is fully released
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453502/42dd891d141ab9d7d14cb5339fa58fc0edcf7b16.png"][/img][/p][h1]You can play right now![/h1][p]The full version of Katharsi is finally ready to be played! After a year of hard work, bug fixing, and listening to your feedback, the wait is over.[/p][p][/p][p]Team Countdown is very excited to have you play our game and give us your feedback, we are planning on having one final update in about a week so share what you think and help us improve Katharsi.[/p]
